taken as written

clue.text: Extinct bird seen in Maldives or Andamans originally

clue.text: Third of computer programs taken out by concealed bugs

clue.text: Good, free, smooth American football

to smooth clothes is to iron them

explanation.definitionFit: Gridiron is the name for American football, from the lined pattern of its field.

clue.text: You'll have grounds for holding this meeting before lunch

clue.text: Turned to welcoming navy personnel receiving a decoration

clue.text: Endless corresponding with pen is tortuous

explanation.walkthrough: MCC is the Marylebone Cricket Club, the historic governing body of cricket based at Lord's in London. Cricket matches traditionally stop for an afternoon tea interval.
explanation.definitionFit: Tea is the refreshment taken in a cricket match's afternoon interval, a description of the drink.

clue.text: Western trek in old area I abandoned: right in the end

clue.text: Partition raised after concern about volume

raised means up

explanation.definitionFit: To live on the breadline is to be just at subsistence level, an idiom for poverty.

clue.text: Regattas regularly supplying food

clue.text: Exotic warrior is holding a curious article up

clue.text: Education? Bent on securing one of its basic components
